Shitet apartament 1+1 ne rrugen Don bosko, prane Fiori di Bosko!
Pozicionohet ne katin e 4 pa ashensor te nje pallati pas viteve 2002.
Organizohet ne korridor qe ben shperndarjet e dhomave, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet me dalje ne ballkon dhe nje kuzhine+dhome ndenje.
Se fundi i jane bere patinim, lyerje dhe disa mobilje te reja.
Apartamenti eshte i dhene me qira 45 000 lek neto ne muaj.
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!
title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN DON BOSCO!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Don Bosco Street, near Fiori di Bosco! It is located on the 4th floor without an elevator of a building after 2002. It is organized in a corridor that divides the rooms, a bedroom, a bathroom with access to the balcony and a kitchen + living room. At the end, they have been patinated, painted and some new furniture. The apartment is rented for 45,000 lek net per month. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
